turns.text: Hi, I am Alex Rivera. My partner Jordan and I are planning a trip to Japan in late March next year.
That is cherry blossom season. Which places are you thinking about?
We chose Tokyo, Kyoto, Kanazawa, and Osaka. We dropped Hiroshima to save time.
A shorter list makes for a calmer trip. Is there anything about getting around that you want to sort out?
I prefer trains to flights, so I want a JR Pass. Jordan is allergic to shellfish, so I need an allergy card for restaurants.
Both are easy to arrange ahead of time. Let me know when you want to start on the details.
On weekends I am learning Rust. I am reading Rust for Rustaceans.
Good book. Do you write Go at work?
Yes, I write Go for services and TypeScript for tooling.
That sounds like a practical mix. How are the weekend sessions going so far?
We chose Postgres partitioning over TimescaleDB for the shipment table. We dropped the idea of self-hosting.
Good to have that settled. Is there anything else on your plate this week?
My manager Dana wants the runbook reviewed by Sam before Friday.
Do you want help putting together a review checklist?
